theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : Rn N → Rn N) (W : Set (Rn N)), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → IsOpen W → tsupport g ⊆ W → ∃ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K ∧ tsupport g ⊆ K ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ ∃ h : ℕ → Rn N → Rn N, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (h k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (h k) ∧ tsupport (h k) ⊆ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly h g atTop
